test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
If 12 is subtracted from each of n values x₁, x₂, ⋯, xₙ, then the sum of the resulting numbers is 92. If 8 is subtracted from each of the n values, then the sum of the numbers is 208. What is the mean of the given n values?

(Give your answer correct to one decimal place.)
solution:
**Given:**

If 12 is subtracted from each of n values x1, x2, ⋯, xn, then the sum of the resulting numbers is 92

If 8 is subtracted from each of the n values, then the sum of the numbers is 208

**Formula Used:**

Mean(Average) = Sum of observation/Number of observation.

**Calculation:**

Let the sum of n values** **x1, x2, x₃ ....., xₙ = X

n be the number of observations.

According to the question,

X - 12n = 92 (12 is substracted n times = 12n) ----(1)

X - 8n = 208 (8 is substracted n times = 8n) ----(2)

Subtract (1) from (2)

⇒ 4n = 116

n = 29

Put the value of n in (2)

X - (8 × 29) = 208

⇒ 208 + 232

⇒ 440

X = 440

Mean of the given n values = Sum of observation/Number of observation

⇒ X/29

⇒ 440/29

⇒ 15.172 ∼ 15.2

**∴ The mean of the given n values is 15.2.**
